journey.name: TL-12 Sorting reorders the list and composes with search
journey.description:
Covers FR-11. TaskSort.PRIORITY sorts descending by priority and TaskSort.COMPLETION puts unfinished first; both are stable, so rows of equal rank keep their source order (lib/tasks-api TaskSort.kt:11-25, asserted in TaskSortTest).
Sorting is a derivation over the cached list, so it must reorder what is displayed without re-reading from the source and without disturbing an active query.
Seed order and ranks: Renew (High), Reply (Medium), Book dentist (Low, completed), Migrate (Medium).
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Sort tasks"
Verify that "Default order", "Priority" and "Unfinished first" are all on screen
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is the first row
Verify that "Book dentist" is the last row
Verify that "Reply to design feedback" appears above "Migrate the analytics pipeline to the new warehouse and validate dashboards"
Tap the element with the content description "Sort tasks"
Verify that "Book dentist" is the last row
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is the first row
Type "e" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that "Book dentist" is still the last row of the filtered list
